title: JanSport 39L Odyssey Backpack, Navy

comparisons.notes: Official JanSport US store. Navy variant SKU JS:00T14G:003, barcode 196248907208, matching the Amazon listing UPC. Variant data shows $110.00 and available.

writeup: Woot relisted the JanSport Odyssey 39L backpack in navy, new, for $29.99, five dollars under its last Woot run. JanSport's own store sells the same navy pack for $110. It has a padded 15-inch laptop sleeve that doubles as a 3-liter hydration pocket and a tuck-away hip belt. Only one was left when we checked, limit three per customer.
